name: Adlet
description: The Adlet are a race of hybrid beings in Inuit mythology — dog from the waist down, human above — said to be taller than humans, hostile, and the offspring of an Inuit woman and a red dog.
origin: Adlet stories are recorded across the eastern Arctic: Greenland (especially Smith Sound), Baffin Island, the Labrador and Hudson Bay coasts, and adjacent inland areas.
